description: The UK Financial Conduct Authority is exploring whether certain tokenised gold products should receive exemptions from existing collective investment scheme and alternative investment fund rules. The discussions with HM Treasury and the Bank of England are aimed at determining whether current regulations are suitable for emerging gold-market infrastructure and whether tokenisation can improve wholesale market efficiency.
title: FCA Explores Regulatory Exemption for Tokenised Gold Products

description: Recent reports indicated that Samsung was testing a 50-megapixel 4x telephoto sensor measuring 1/1.9-inch for the Galaxy S27 Ultra. The brand was rumoured to replace the existing 3x and 5x telephoto cameras with a single 4x sensor. Now, tipster Ice Universe has challenged these rumours, claiming that the Galaxy S27 Ultra will continue to feature a 5x telephoto camera with a 1/2.52-inch sensor.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Said to Retain 5x Telephoto Camera; May Ditch Dedicated 3x Camera

description: Lava Virat Curve will be launched in India on September 21 at 12 pm IST. The new smartphone will be available for purchase in the country via Flipkart. Moreover, it is confirmed to go on sale in India in two colour options, namely Heritage Indigo and Makrana Ivory. The  Lava Virat Curve will be equipped with a 50-megapixel primary shooter on the back with a Sony IMX752 sensor, an f/1.8 aperture, 10x digital zoom, and a 79-degree field of view. Moreover, it will be powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC, along with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of onboard storage.
title: Lava Virat Curve India Launch Date Revealed Along With Key Specifications, Colour Options and More

description: Samsung Galaxy A08 4G has appeared on Virgin Megastore UAE, giving a look at its expected hardware and pricing ahead of launch. The retailer lists the phone with a 6.7-inch PLS LCD, 90Hz refresh rate, up to 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. Other listed features include a 50-megapixel main camera, 6,000mAh battery, 25W charging and IP64 protection. The Galaxy A08 4G is priced at AED 625 (roughly Rs. 16,300) in the UAE for the 4GB RAM and 64GB storage configuration.
title: Samsung Galaxy A08 4G Appears on UAE Retailer With 6,000mAh Battery Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Oppo Watch S2 is now available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo China online store. The new smartwatch will go on sale in China in three colour options, namely “Vibrant Orange”, “Misty Powder”, and “Mountain Shadow Grey” (translated from Chinese). The company has also revealed the design and other details of the soon-to-be-launched smartwatch. The Oppo Watch S2 will offer the effective “fat-burning gram visualisation”. The upcoming smartwatch will also feature an upgraded health-tracking sensor. The optical sensor is claimed to deliver 75 percent enhanced anti-interference (translated from Chinese), along with claimed exercise heart rate accuracy of 98.8 percent.
title: Oppo Watch S2 to Launch Alongside Find X10 Series With Upgraded Health Tracking Sensor

description: An APK teardown of the Google Play Services version 26.36.30 reportedly indicate that Google may be developing a new “Expert features” section within the Advanced Protection settings. Intrusion Detection, USB Protection, and Unsecured Wi-Fi Networks options will likely fall under this optional “Expert features” section. Google is expected to make the unsecured Wi-Fi protection optional.
title: Google May Soon Give Android Users More Control Over Advanced Protection Features; Suggests APK Teardown

description: Vivo Y600i and Y600i AI Edition have received another certification ahead of their expected launch, with the listing revealing support for 44W wired charging. The two smartphones were previously linked to the same model number and device code on the Google Play Console. Meanwhile, another Vivo handset identified as V2620A has appeared with around 90W charging support. The model could be related to the Vivo X500 series, although its commercial name and connection to the upcoming flagship lineup remain unconfirmed.
title: Vivo Y600i, Y600i AI Edition Charging Specs Leak Ahead of Expected Debut

description: Xiaomi 18's global variant has reportedly appeared on Singapore's IMDA certification database under model number 2611FPNFAG. The listing identifies the handset as a 5G smartphone and mentions Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and NFC connectivity. The same model has previously appeared on Taiwan's NCC and Europe's EEC certification platforms. The NCC listing reportedly revealed 256GB and 512GB storage options, IP68 protection and a charger capable of 100W wired charging. The Xiaomi 18 series is expected to debut in China before reaching international markets.
title: Xiaomi 18 Worldwide Debut Inches Closer Following First Major Regulatory Move

description: Symbiosis recovered around 15 BTC after an attacker exploited a flaw in its Bitcoin Bridge on September 11. The protocol suspended native Bitcoin routes and isolated the affected bridge while keeping other cross-chain routes operational. Symbiosis has not disclosed the total loss and is still assessing the impact on liquidity providers.
title: Symbiosis Recovers 15 BTC Following Attack on syBTC Minting

description: iQOO 16 will be launched as the world’s first phone to feature a 2K resolution that refreshes at up to 165Hz, the Vivo sub-brand has announced. Moreover, it will debut as the world’s first Android phone to get Samsung’s new AMOLED panel, with the latest M16 luminescent material. While the size of iQOO 16’s display remains under wraps, it is confirmed to ship with Samsung’s second-generation LEAD [Low Power, Eco-Friendly, Augmented Brightness, and Design Slim and Light], or LEAD 2.0, display technology.
title: iQOO 16 to Launch as the World’s First Android Phone With Samsung’s M16 2K AMOLED Display

description: Revolut said a limited number of customers were affected after an unauthorised party used a legitimate government agency email domain to submit fraudulent information requests. The exposed data may include identity documents, contact details, selfie authentication images, account statements, and transaction history. Revolut said its systems and customer funds remain unaffected.
title: Revolut Customers Hit by Data Exposure From Fake Government Email

description: Apple will likely equip the third generation of the iPhone Duo with a telephoto camera and Face ID sensor, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter ‘Power On’. Gurman explains that these two upgrades for the iPhone Duo are the “top two priorities” for Apple. However, it is difficult for the tech giant to equip a telephoto camera and a Face ID sensor in the handset because of the 5.2mm thickness when unfolded, which also makes it the thinnest iPhone model yet. Both components reportedly require more depth, making it a “physics problem”.
title: Apple Likely to Equip Third-Generation iPhone Duo With a Face ID Sensor, Telephoto Camera: Mark Gurman Predicts

description: Kraton India has released yet another set of redeem codes for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). The latest drop brings the Cobalt Storm Backpack, alongside other exclusive in-game rewards. There are 50 BGMI redeem codes available, although each code can be used by a maximum of 10 players on a first-come, first-served basis. The codes are part of the game's 5th Anniversary Edition 4.5 Update, while the company has also announced that the BGMI 4.6 Update will land soon.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for September 14: How to Get Cobalt Storm Backpack and Other Free Rewards

description: Oppo will introduce the Find X10 series in China on September 22, bringing three smartphones alongside the Watch S2 and Enco X4. The Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max will come with up to 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage, while the Find X10E will have fewer configurations. The phones will feature distinct camera designs, with up to three 200-megapixel rear cameras on the Pro Max. Other reported details include an 8,000mAh battery, Tiangong Screen 2.0 display and new Dimensity chipsets.
title: Oppo Find X10, X10 Pro Max and X10E Launch Date Announced; Colourways, RAM and Storage Options Confirmed

description: Realme P4s Lite may launch soon. The company has yet to reveal the phone's launch timeline or moniker, but the phone has surfaced on the Google Play Supported Devices list with model number RMX5398. It is rumoured to arrive as a budget offering and could pack 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of onboard storage.
title: Realme P4s Lite Launch Seems Imminent as Handset Lands on Google Play Supported Devices List

description: Apple is reportedly working on two game controllers designed for the iPhone, with Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman saying they could launch under the Beats brand. The controllers, identified by the codenames T6502 and T1057, were previously spotted in macOS 26.7 code with different haptic and motion capabilities. Both are said to include standard gamepad controls, while one reportedly adds an accelerometer and gyroscope. Apple has not confirmed the devices or revealed their pricing and availability.
title: Apple Could Launch Two iPhone Game Controllers Under Beats Branding

description: Anthropic's CEO, Dario Amodei, has reignited an important conversation about the risks posed by the fast-paced development of frontier AI models. He said, “Like many technologies before it, AI brings risks, and because it is such a powerful technology, these risks are serious.” Amodei further says, “We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain.” Anthropic’s CEO has a three-part plan for AI frontier firms. The proposed plan is claimed to ensure safety, allowing the companies to tread carefully.
title: AI Leaders Reach Consensus: Amodei, Altman, Musk, and Hassabis on Extinction Risks

description: The unannounced Moto G67s Power surfaced on the Geekbench website, suggesting it may soon make its way to markets. It got 687 points in the single-core test and 1,088 points in the multi-core test. As per the listing, the Moto G67s Power runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 6400. It also shows 4GB of RAM and runs Android 16.
title: Moto G67s Power Specifications Revealed by Geekbench Listing, May Come With MediaTek Dimensity 6400 SoC

description: Bitcoin is holding near Rs. 74.2 lakh as subdued selling offers some stability, while recent ETF outflows indicate weaker institutional support at higher prices. On-chain data shows older holders are not selling heavily, but a tougher macro backdrop and the upcoming Fed decision could keep the market volatile.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $77,500 as Institutional Support Weakens at Higher Prices

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE was launched in India on Monday as the company’s latest ‘Fan Edition’ model. It arrives as the successor to last year’s Galaxy S26 FE and sports a 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset is powered by the Exynos 2500 processor and features a triple rear camera setup with a 50-megapixel primary sensor and 3x optical zoom. The Galaxy S26 FE runs on One UI 9 based on Android 17 and is the Galaxy S26 series model to launch with the latest software.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Launched in India With Exynos 2500 Chip, 4,900mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X500 series will launch in China soon. While Vivo remains tight-lipped about its global launch, international variants of the Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max have surfaced on the certification platform. The listing suggests a global launch may be on the cards. The Vivo X500 reportedly appeared on Malaysia's SIRIM database with model number V2619.  The Vivo X500 Pro Max and Vivo X500 Pro are reportedly listed with model numbers V2610 and V2621, respectively.
title: Vivo X500 Global Launch Inch Closer as New Flagship Bags SIRIM Approval

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is expected to be launched in India soon, following its global debut earlier this month. The handset will arrive as the latest addition to the South Korean tech conglomerate’s ‘Fan Edition’ lineup. Multiple microsites also recently went live, teasing its impending arrival. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked the pricing for the upcoming handset and confirmed two variants of the Galaxy S26 FE for the Indian market.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Price in India, Storage Variants Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: OnePlus 16 will not be launched in India, as a tipster claims that the OnePlus 16R will be the smartphone maker's next flagship handset in the country. The leaker claims that the smartphone maker will employ a “very different” strategy by launching the rumoured OnePlus 16R as its flagship phone in India. The handset is said to debut in the country in 2027. The tech firm will reportedly unveil the next-generation Nord lineup phones later, which could be marketed as Nord 7, Nord CE 7, and Nord CE 7 Lite. The recently introduced OnePlus N series will be launched in the country after the debut of the OnePlus Nord 7 lineup. It might follow a similar naming scheme, arriving as the OnePlus N7 lineup.
title: OnePlus 16 Might Not Launch in India as OnePlus 16R Will Lead Firm's New Product Strategy, Tipster Claims

description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo has appeared on the Geekbench benchmarking platform. The listing reveals details about its processor, RAM and software. The smartphone is confirmed to launch in India soon. Motorola has not yet announced its complete specifications. Motorola earlier this month announced that the Edge 70 Neo will launch in India soon. Previous design leaks suggested the phone would come in dark green, light blue, olive green and pale pink colour options.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo Geekbench Listing Reveals Chipset Ahead of India Launch

description: Oppo could introduce two new F-series smartphones in India, with a leaked poster offering an early look at their designs and hardware. The alleged Oppo F35 and F35 Pro are tipped to occupy the Rs. 40,000 and Rs. 45,000 price segments, respectively. Their reported chipsets correspond with those used by the Oppo A7 Pro and A7 Pro Max in China. Other leaked details include 120Hz AMOLED displays, 50-megapixel selfie cameras, horizontal rear camera modules and batteries of around 10,000mAh.
title: Oppo F35 Series is Coming: Rebranded Design, Leaked Prices, and Key Upgrades

description: Apple launched the new-generation iPhone models — the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max — at its ‘Surprise and shine’ event last week. Following their debut, the Cupertino-based tech giant discontinued the previous-gen Pro models. Buyers, however, can still grab at significantly lower effective prices through new retail offers. The latest deals offer the iPhone 17 Pro down to as low as Rs. 69,990, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max is available at an effective deal price of tRs. 74,990.
title: iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max Get Big Discounts in India Ahead of iPhone 18 Pro Sale: Check Offers

description: Apple is reportedly preparing a design overhaul of its retail stores. New and upgraded retail stores will feature three major changes: a revamped Avenue, a return to dedicated Genius Bars, and the removal of the giant video walls found in many locations. The revamped stores will have wooden bays for online order pickups and Today at Apple sessions. Apple could also refresh employee areas and back-of-house areas.
title: The Genius Bar is Coming Back: Apple Reportedly Axing Store Video Walls

description: Xiaomi Pad 9 and Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro have been launched in China as the latest additions to the company’s tablet lineup. Both tablets sport 3.2K displays with up to a 144Hz adaptive refresh rate and 1,000 nits of peak brightness. The standard Pad 9 is powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, while the Pro model runs on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor. The Xiaomi Pad 9 and Pad 9 Pro run on HyperOS 4.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro With 144Hz Displays, Snapdragon Chipsets Launched: Price, Specifications

description: Apple has revealed a regional difference in the modem used by the iPhone 18 Pro Max. The company’s updated specifications indicate that the device uses its C2 cellular modem globally, except in the US, where reports point to a Qualcomm modem instead. The change does not affect the iPhone 18 Pro, which uses the C2 worldwide. The exact Qualcomm modem remains unknown, although the Snapdragon X85 is considered the likely candidate. Apple has not explained why the US model uses different hardware.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max US Model Reportedly Misses Apple’s C2 Modem

description: Apple is all set to roll out iOS 27 for compatible iPhone models in India and globally today, September 14. The latest software update, which was first previewed at WWDC 2026, has gone through several developer and public beta releases. At the ‘September and shine’ event last week, the tech giant announced that the iPhone 18 Pro models and iPhone Duo would be the first models to ship with the new OS out of the box. iOS 27 brings a redesigned Siri experience powered by Apple's Foundation Models and Google's Gemini, alongside a refreshed Liquid Glass interface, Visual Intelligence upgrades and new parental controls.
title: iOS 27 Update for iPhone Rolling Out Today: How to Download, India Release Time, Supported iPhones and More
